import asyncio


async def save(x):
    return x


def use(x):
    pass


# CASE awaited_local_function expect=fire
async def h1(items):
    for item in items:
        async def step():
            await save(item)
        await step()


# CASE join_per_pass expect=fire
async def h2(groups):
    for group in groups:
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(x) for x in group))


# CASE try_finally expect=fire
async def h3(items):
    for item in items:
        try:
            use(item)
        finally:
            await save(item)


# CASE enumerate_destructure expect=fire
async def h4(items):
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        await save((i, item))


# CASE while_pop expect=fire
async def h5(items):
    while items:
        await save(items.pop())


# CASE await_in_call_arg expect=fire
async def h6(items):
    for item in items:
        use(await save(item))


# CASE wait_for_per_item expect=fire
async def h7(items):
    for item in items:
        await asyncio.wait_for(save(item), 1)
